Core Design Law A Belavadös railway is not a road with metal strips or a miracle engine dragged through towns. It is a guided civic corridor where track geometry, wheel contact, traction, braking distance, signal authority, passenger mass, cargo custody, and divine-material discipline decide whether speed becomes safety.
